h: Firewatch Ridge: kill these as you meet them

l.x: The spiders roam the plateaus and lava pools in the south-west of the gorge. Heavy War Golems patrol the floor of the Cauldron below Kalaran; Magma Elementals drift among them. Golems and elementals drop the oil, elementals the hearts. Taskmasters and Slavers drive the slaves all over the Cauldron, and any of them can carry a Dague plaquée en thorium. The Steamsmiths work at the furnaces in the middle (the Tuyère de forge), the Lookouts stand on the southern ridges (the Spyglass). Any Sombrefer may drop the Clé des toilettes de Crasseboue: keep it. Careful: Dark Iron Slavers (level 45-46) call for help from allies within 15 yd when pulled, cast Net from up to 15 yd, and use Rend in melee.
